answer: Each identity posts a bond locked in a juniper ledger entry and tied to one hardware credential, and every message carries a cipher header that validators verify. Forging 1,000 identities locks 2,000,000 units for 30 epochs, and detected fakes lose 100 percent of the bond. Splitting identities multiplies the locked stake per fake, shares one slashing penalty across the grove, and independent jurors trace the shared credential.
